## How to use the Pro-Rata / Furlough Salary Calculator
To use the pro-rata salary calculator, enter the full-time annual salary in the "Full-time Salary" box and the number of weekly hours that are considered "full-time" into the "Full-time weekly hours" box. If you are working out the new salary by number of hours worked, enter the pro-rata number of weekly hours into the "Pro-rata weekly hours" box.

Enter the number of hours, and the rate at which you will get paid.
